description.translate: Twelve sheets of paper will let me restore the refuge register and copy the witness notes. Names first, supplies second. No one who sheltered here is becoming a tally mark in another report. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

The Ranker brought me his ring after capturing the dragon's flight, the Snow Queen's shielding and the Hydra's vitality. My engraving made its protective ward usable, but flight and its greater recovery remained sealed. I took it away to study the unfinished binding. I owe you the account of how I lost it.
